lore.mynethersdelight.powdery_cannon: A Nether cane that grows in Crimson Forests. Cut it on a Cutting Board for Gunpowder, or pack it into Powdery Cane Blocks.
lore.mynethersdelight.powdery_chubby_sap: A young Powdery Cane. Plant it in a Crimson Forest to grow Powdery Cane and Bullet Peppers.
lore.mynethersdelight.spicy_noodle_soup: A Ramen cooked in a Cooking Pot with Fried Egg, a hot spice and raw Hogchop.
lore.mynethersdelight.ghast_salad: A Salad tossed with Raw Ghast and Carrot.
lore.mynethersdelight.spicy_skewer: A Skewer threaded with Bullet Pepper and raw Strider.
lore.mynethersdelight.bacon-wrapped_saus: A Skewer threaded with Cooked Sausage and Cooked Bacon.
lore.mynethersdelight.egg_soup: A Soup cooked in a Cooking Pot with Boiled Egg, 2 Fried Eggs and Onion.
lore.mynethersdelight.spicy_hoglin_stew: A Soup cooked in a Cooking Pot with Hogchop, Potato, Carrot and Bullet Pepper or Pepper Powder.
lore.mynethersdelight.golden_egg: A Boiled Egg wrapped in Gold.
lore.mynethersdelight.hotdog_with_mixed_: A Hot Dog topped with Mixed Salad.
lore.mynethersdelight.hotdog_with_nether: A Hot Dog topped with Nether Salad.
lore.mynethersdelight.nether_burger: A burger made with Cooked Hogchop, Twisting Vines and Nether fungi.
lore.mynethersdelight.red_loin_on_a_stic: Cooked Hogchop skewered with Crimson Fungus and Red Mushroom.
lore.mynethersdelight.scotch_eggs: Boiled Eggs wrapped in sausage meat and breadcrumbs.
lore.mynethersdelight.twisted_ghasta: Ghast Tentacles cooked with Warped Fungus and Twisting Vines.
lore.mynethersdelight.stuffed_pepper: A food made from Bullet Pepper, Cooked Pork and Milk.
lore.mynethersdelight.golden_trophy: A golden trophy to show off your achievements.
lore.mynethersdelight.pepper_powder: Ground Bullet Pepper. A spicy seasoning that warms you up in the cold.
lore.mynethersdelight.blue_tenderloin_st: A hearty Cooked Hogchop served with Warped Fungus and roots.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_striderlo: A serving of Striderloaf. Place the Striderloaf next to lava or on a heat source and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.striderloaf_block: A roast Strider that stays hot next to lava or on a heat source and cools off anywhere else. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_cold_stri: A serving of Cold Striderloaf. A placed Striderloaf cools off away from lava and heat; use a Bowl on it then to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.cold_striderloaf_b: A Striderloaf left to cool away from lava and heat; break it before taking any servings to pick it up. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_ghasta_wi: A serving of Ghast Tentacles with Cream. Place the Ghast Tentacles with Cream and use a Bowl on it to take a serving.
lore.mynethersdelight.ghasta_with_cream_: A Ghast Tentacle feast that slowly grows back while at least 2 servings are left. Place it and use a Bowl on it to take each of its 4 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.magma_cake_slice: A slice of Magma Cake. Use a Knife on a placed Magma Cake to cut a slice, or cut the whole cake on a Cutting Board.
lore.mynethersdelight.magma_cake_block: A fiery cake that burns anyone who walks on it. Place it and use a Knife on it to cut 7 slices.
lore.mynethersdelight.stuffed_hoglin: A whole roasted Hoglin that takes up two blocks. Place it, cut off its 2 ears with a Knife, then use a Bowl on it to take its 9 servings.
lore.mynethersdelight.roast_ear: A crispy Hoglin Ear from a Stuffed Hoglin. Use a Knife on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to cut off one of its 2 ears.
lore.mynethersdelight.plate_of_stuffed_h: The first serving of a Stuffed Hoglin. Cut both ears off a placed Stuffed Hoglin with a Knife, then use a Bowl on it to take the snout.
A serving of Hoglin Ham. Once the snout is gone, use a Bowl on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to take one of its 4 ham servings.
A serving of Hoglin Ribs. Once the ham is gone, use a Bowl on a placed Stuffed Hoglin to take one of its last 4 servings.
effect.mynethersdelight.b_pungent.desc: Sets you alight near heat. The flames go out once you move away.
mynethersdelight.jei.info.fungus_colony: Crimson and Warped Fungus form colonies when planted on Rich Soil.
item.mynethersdelight.plate_of_ghasta_wi: Plate of Ghast Tentacles with Cream
